description: Additional acceptance inputs authored by the implementation lead after the helper development rubric was frozen; evaluate without tuning against these cases.

cases.text: Hey, could you make a quick packing list for a one-night business trip?
We have five days in Italy with a six-year-old and my elderly father. Compare Rome and Florence, including walking distances, summer heat, train access and hotels, then propose a realistic itinerary.
Four roommates split a hundred and twenty dollar electricity bill equally. How much should each person pay?

Compare paying an extra five hundred dollars toward debt each month with keeping it as emergency savings. Use income of forty-five hundred, expenses of thirty-five hundred, an emergency fund of one thousand and debt at twenty percent interest. Explain the tradeoffs.
Quick question, what is the largest planet in our solar system?

Compare battery electric and hydrogen buses for a small city's transit fleet. Research lifecycle emissions, maintenance, charging or fueling infrastructure, and weather constraints; make the assumptions explicit.

Perform an exhaustive technical investigation of a distributed payment ledger under Byzantine faults, network partitions and crash recovery. Develop and prove the consistency invariants, analyze interacting failure scenarios and compare competing protocol architectures in a detailed report.
Please open Safari on this Mac.
On my Mac, open the current spreadsheet, locate the quarterly totals, update the visible chart labels and verify that the changes appear in the saved document.
Make a Drake meme: reject another meeting, approve an email instead.
Uh, can you handle the thing from before, you know the one?
Write an original bedtime fairy tale about a talking fox and a sleepy moon.

bots.name: Trip Planner
bots.description: Plans vacations and travel: destinations, itineraries, flights, hotels, packing and accessibility.

bots.name: Budget Planner
bots.description: Builds household or group budgets, calculates expenses and fair cost splits, compares financial scenarios.

bots.name: Research & Reports
bots.description: Finds reliable factual answers, researches technical and scientific questions, compares evidence and writes reports.

bots.name: Mac Operator
bots.description: Operates websites and authorized Mac apps: opens apps, navigates screens, edits visible forms and verifies actions.

bots.name: Meme Lord
bots.description: Creates funny memes from image templates or user-supplied images and caption text.
